NinMagic Saves reboot workflow

The bpc:ams reboot client follows the GPL-2.0-only Atmosphere reference client:
Copyright (c) Atmosphere-NX.
https://github.com/Atmosphere-NX/Atmosphere/tree/master/troposphere/reboot_to_payload

Adapted 2026-11-03 for explicit NinMagic confirmation, runtime checks, a RAM-only
Hekate boot configuration and a manual fallback on unsupported hardware.
The Hekate boot_cfg ABI is documented by CTCaer/hekate:
https://github.com/CTCaer/hekate

NinMagic Saves program source is distributed under GPL-2.0-only (see LICENSE).
Corresponding source: https://github.com/ANE-JV/ninmagic-saves
Branding assets retain their separate ownership. Bundled libraries and font
retain the licenses supplied alongside this notice.
